correctness.rationale: At a translated Chern-critical Gaussian entire-function peak the independent jets satisfy a1=0, with s=|a0|² and t=|a2|²; the positive Jacobian for maxima is (s-2t)+, whose expectation 1/3 normalizes Palm density 3(s-2t)exp(-s-t) on s>2t. The -1/2 real log-Hessian is I plus the traceless matrix determined by c=sqrt(2)a2/a0; positivity is |c|<1, giving K=(1+|c|)/(1-|c|). Changing variable U=2t/s yields density 3(1-U)/(1+U/2)^3 and survival ((1-U)/(1+U/2))². Exact transformation gives P(K>r)=64r²/(3r²+2r+3)², hence finite E K but infinite E K². Under height s>=h, s/h->1 and t|s tends in total variation to unit Exp, so sqrt(h)c tends to two independent N(0,1) components. Congruence by diag(e^b,e^-b) yields high-peak eigenvalue splitting: b_h sqrt(h)->eta gives twice shifted planar Gaussian radius, with the stated Rician density; fixed nonzero b gives N(0,4) fluctuations about e^(4|b|). Independently integrated the U density and verified exact curvature-tail algebra at r=1,1.1,2,5,10,100; random/simulated checks alone cannot prove distributional convergence.
